import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2023', header=None)
# Look under NOT ADJUSTED section (rows before ADJUSTED)
adjusted_idx = df[df[1].astype(str).str.contains('ADJUSTED', na=False) & ~df[1].astype(str).str.contains('NOT ADJUSTED', na=False)].index[0]
not_adj_df = df.iloc[:adjusted_idx]

furniture_row = not_adj_df[not_adj_df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Furniture stores'].index[0]
electronics_row = not_adj_df[not_adj_df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Electronics stores'].index[0]

furniture_total = float(df.iloc[furniture_row, 14])
electronics_total = float(df.iloc[electronics_row, 14])

result = df.iloc[furniture_row, 1] if furniture_total > electronics_total else df.iloc[electronics_row, 1]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2020', header=None)
adjusted_idx = df[df[1].astype(str).str.contains('ADJUSTED', na=False) & ~df[1].astype(str).str.contains('NOT ADJUSTED', na=False)].index[0]
not_adj_df = df.iloc[:adjusted_idx]

row_idx = not_adj_df[not_adj_df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Food services and drinking places'].index[0]
months = df.iloc[4, 2:14].tolist() # row 5 has column headers
values = df.iloc[row_idx, 2:14].astype(float).tolist()
min_val_idx = values.index(min(values))
min_month_str = months[min_val_idx] # e.g. 'Apr. 2020'
# parse to YYYY-MM
dt = pd.to_datetime(min_month_str.replace('.', ''))
result = dt.strftime('%Y-%m')

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2022', header=None)
adjusted_idx = df[df[1].astype(str).str.contains('ADJUSTED', na=False) & ~df[1].astype(str).str.contains('NOT ADJUSTED', na=False)].index[0]
adj_df = df.iloc[adjusted_idx:]

total_row = adj_df[adj_df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Retail and food services sales, total'].index[0]
monthly_sales = df.iloc[total_row, 2:14].astype(float)
result = monthly_sales.mean()
